response.justification: Bogdan brings 15+ years of hands-on software development with genuine, demonstrable depth in developer tooling and testing infrastructure (authored the Trial test runner and Fluent-Asserts libraries, built CI/CD and device-orchestration tooling, ran GitLab/CI/deploy infrastructure, and now works on MCP code generators and agent developer tooling). However, the role is fundamentally a people-leadership position, and the resume shows no evidence of formal people management, direct reports, performance reviews, or organizational leadership — the 2-year people-management minimum appears unmet, and 'technical leadership' is only implied via Staff titles, community teaching, and founding an open-source project. Mobile-platform exposure is limited to a single iOS/tvOS stint a decade ago. He could be a strong senior/staff IC or a first-time manager candidate, but is a stretch for a Level II Manager hire.
strengths: Deep, authentic developer-tools and test-infrastructure portfolio (test runner, assertion library, CI/CD, dev-ops)
15+ years of broad engineering experience across web, mobile, desktop, and embedded systems
Proven mentorship and knowledge-sharing: workshops, Selenium course curriculum, refactoring dojos, conference talks
concerns: No documented people-management experience or direct reports (hard minimum for the role)
No evidence of roadmap ownership, org-level change leadership, or cross-team alignment at scale
Mobile-platform experience is thin and dated (single iOS/Apple TV project ~2015-2016)

key_factors.factor: Strong developer-tools and testing infrastructure depth
Limited technical leadership scope and mobile-ecosystem exposure
